verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents an auto-shutdown feature that stops a machine after a set period of inactivity, configurable from one hour to one week. That directly covers the forgotten-instance scenario through the story's 'auto-shutdown timers' option. Missing for 10: any evidence of spend limits or budget caps, detail on configuring auto-shutdown via API/CLI or for Notebooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the shutdown works reliably.
